title: Resolution urging Albany to add license points for illegal racing
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.1768/A.2585, the "Drag Racing and Speeding Enforcement Act." The bill would add five points to a driver's license for anyone convicted of participating in illegal speed contests or drag races, on top of existing criminal penalties. The Council argues this would add an extra deterrent against dangerous racing that endangers drivers, pedestrians and bystanders.
